ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( RecordType.Name = 'Parent Opportunity', $User.Bypass_VR__c = FALSE, $Profile.Name != 'Xendit API Profile', ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Evaluation'), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName)), OR( ISBLANK ( Pains_Priorities_and_Needs__c ), ISBLANK( TEXT(Has_Competitor__c) ), AND( TEXT(Has_Competitor__c) = 'Yes', ISBLANK( Primary_Competitor__c ) ), OR ( No_of_Contact_Roles__c < 1, ISBLANK (No_of_Contact_Roles__c), LEN(Sales_Goals_Plan__c) = 0 ) ) ), true, false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To set stage as Evaluation, make sure all fields in Evaluation and Discovery Stage sections are filled, and at least 1 Contact Role has been added to the Opportunity.
